Sylvie Tran

subject: RE: EV charger request - Unit 210
body:
Hi Sam,

As mentioned, yours is the first request of this kind here - no completed installations in Maple Court yet.

In general, the Board will need to approve:
- electrical capacity review (engineer/electrician)
- a licensed contractor for the work
- a cost/ownership model (owner pays; metering; common element impacts)

If you can share the charger type you're considering (Level 2, amperage) and your stall number (thank you), we can start with an electrical feasibility check.

Regards,
Dana

Thanks,
Sam (Unit 210)
